title: Kagamine Len — Card Story

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm, this is a pretty mellow song.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I didn't know Len had such songs in his repertoire.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The first time I heard this song, I was surprised too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I always thought Len was a rock singer, but after searching around, I found out he sings in many different styles...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Even a mellow and mature song like this one suits him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I could listen to this forever...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, look at this, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is everyone having fun?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin! I'm still singing here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But the next song is a duet of ours, right?
So it's okay for me to come out...oh wait.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe, I forgot my microphone!
Lend me yours, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So that you can hog it for yourself?
No, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Len and Rin are so close to each other.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! When you see them together, it gives you this sense of reassurance and peace, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because the two of them being together feels very natural to us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly. They're both Kagamine, after all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I don't know...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't see Rin and Len as twins or family members at all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe...you see them as partners?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah, that's it! That's exactly what I was thinking, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Partners who uplift and support each other.
That's the image I have of them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You really want them to stay close even if they fight, because they're partners.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess it can't be helped...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
How about a mic relay, then?
We'll pass each other the mic when it gets to our own parts.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun!
Let's do that, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright! Don't forget to time it correctly!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It'll be fine! Who do you think we are?
We'll ace the timing, don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, thanks for waiting, everyone! Let the music begin!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, perfect timing, just like they said.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's what happens when you have an unbreakable bond!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is everyone having fun?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin! I'm still singing here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But the next song is a duet of ours, right?
So it's okay for me to come out...oh wait.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe, I forgot my microphone!
Lend me yours, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So that you can hog it for yourself?
No, thank you!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's fine, you had committee duty.
Besides, I found a great way to pass time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What great way?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here, look.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
How about a mic relay, then?
We'll pass each other the mic when it gets to our own parts.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun!
Let's do that, Len!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A video of a VIRTUAL SINGER event?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. My classmates were talking about it, so I took a look.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you already know about it, does that mean your class was talking about it, too?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Some of them were watching it too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Kagamine Rin and Kagemine Len, huh?
I didn't know their voices were so adaptable.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. And Len can also reach a pretty high range, like Rin.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've heard that it's one of his main features, but... What's going to happen when his voice breaks?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You know, Kagamine Len is supposedly fourteen, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My voice broke when I was a first year in middle school. That's earlier than Len's supposed age.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So I was just wondering what sort of voice would he have once his voice broke, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're right. A 14-year-old boy hitting such a high register is quite something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, since Len is a VIRTUAL SINGER, I doubt his voice will ever break...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you still can't help but be curious about it, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I suppose...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, let's sing the chorus together!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He has a clear vocal quality unique to boys of that age. The feelings he puts inside are also easy to understand.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It'll be really interesting to see what a voice like that changes to when it breaks, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: His range will probably drop, but it's likely he'll gain a more powerful voice in return.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: From a pure boy soprano voice to a powerful tenor, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I would love to hear it, but I just can't imagine it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehe!
That was fun, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for listening to us, everyone!
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that we're here, do you want to go to MEIKO's cafe?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm sure everyone else is there already.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, hello there...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Len! Hi!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's great to see you again!
What are you up to?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We thought we'd come by after practice to say hi to everyone. We were just going to the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'm going there too.
Let's walk together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you help out at the cafe too?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, I only visit as a customer, but Miku does help out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've got another important job in this world as a DJ!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But where's your kit? The turntable and the amp? I've never seen you carrying anything like that around.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heh heh heh.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You think I'm not carrying them right now?
But... I've got this pocket here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: D-Do you have a whole other dimension in your pocket?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's a strange world, this SEKAI... Different rules might apply here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Got ya! I was just kidding.
I don't have a magical pocket.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You don't?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It is a mysterious world, but it's not magical.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I would have believed you if you said it was. It wouldn't surprise me if you could make things appear just by wishing for them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I thought the same.
A lot about this world really is inexplicable.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I wish we could use magic here!
The DJ's kit is awfully heavy and a pain to carry around!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, I bet it is.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I used to think that you guys were almost supernatural beings... But you're not that different from us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Our special power is helping people discover their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And that's about it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But that's an amazing power to have!
Without that, we wouldn't even be here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes. Don't sell yourself short!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If you say so.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You did just enough to make it all happen, but not too much so that it would stop us from facing our problems.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly. Some problems have to be solved without help, even when they're very difficult.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're tremendously grateful to you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you so much for everything, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel better knowing you see it like that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Buuut, there's something else I can do for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And what's that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm the DJ, so, obviously, I'm going to do some DJing for you when we get to the cafe!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That'd be sweet!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, let's go, go, go!
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you looking for Len, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I've got to ask him something.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He wasn't at the cafe, so I thought he might be around here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
There he is!
Hey, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, hello!
Good to see you back in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Len, did you patch things up with your partner?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You mean Rin?
Oh yeah, ages ago!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah, good.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... Was that the only thing you wanted to talk to me about?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito's been very concerned about you and Rin having that falling out earlier.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's been looking for you to ask you about it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, that's really kind of you, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wasn't very concerned, but it's been on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He went to the cafe many times trying to find you, but you were never there. Don't you work at MEIKO's cafe?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, I don't actually.
I only go there for coffee.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do you like, have a job?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sure I do! I'm a DJ!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A DJ? Really...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But don't you work with Rin as a duo?
Are you DJing together?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe, we do!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know lots of DJs, but they all work solo.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How does it work with two DJs?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm, how to explain it...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sometimes we're mixing together, other times one of us sings while the other mixes.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So even though we work as a pair, we do have our solo parts too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: As a team, you get to offer a more varied experience.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The best part is when together we accomplish something we couldn't do on our own!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Isn't that the same for you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You can still perform solo, but you can also sing with one, two, or three other people.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that gives us lots of options to try out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did Len give you some food for thought?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I won't deny I got some new ideas just now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to finding out what they are.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If you're going to be putting on shows, I'd like to see them!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, you're welcome as the audience or you can join in if you like.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? I'm going to make use of that invite!
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sigh... I do want to patch things up with Rin, but I don't know how to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Akito, good luck!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you all for the help.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But Akito was so determined to make up with Toya as well. I can do this too...
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: MEIKO! Is Rin here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hello, Len.
Rin was here just a short while ago.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... I must have just missed her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, looks like you're ready to make up with her?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yes... I don't really have the courage, but I also know I can't keep letting this drag on.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'd be so uncool if I didn't at least try after encouraging someone else to make up with his friend, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll go look for Rin again!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'm sure she'll understand if you talk to her properly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, when Rin was in the shop just now, she was telling me she wanted to patch things up with you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What? Rin said that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. She said she wanted to patch things up and then have some lemon soda together with you again.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, okay. I have to find her quickly, then!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll be fine. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks! See you later!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hey, it's dangerous to break into a run like that.
Be careful...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yikes! Ah, sorry... Huh? Rin?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh my...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... Rin, I just...need to talk to you about something.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yes... Um, maybe we can go over there?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Looks like everything's going to work out right.
You can do this, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Humhuuum♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hello, again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Judging from your expression, you've managed to patch things up with Rin, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That I did!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin actually listened and understood what I had to say. If I'd known it'd be so easy, I would've done it sooner!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You two have always been thick as thieves, after all. I'm glad everything's fine between you now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: After making up, we started singing at the street outside. It was really fun to sing with Rin again after so long!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku showed up halfway through, and they're singing together now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I guess I should start preparing some lemon soda, then?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe! I came back again because I thought of the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Can I order some for takeout? I'm going to take the drinks to Miku and Rin.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright. Three lemon sodas it is.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why not four?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You should join us once in a while too, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's not like there are any customers around right now... I'll help you out with the cafe later in return!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Since you asked so nicely, maybe I should oblige.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To celebrate you and Rin making up with each other.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe, great!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Four lemon sodas, and a Closed sign...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Done. Shall we go now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Miku and Rin are gonna be so happy to see you!
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hi everyone... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Ah, Len.
Hello.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey. We're here again.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Len's really a regular customer here, huh?
You never came here at all the last time we were looking for you, though.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad we could meet you here today.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Everyone's here!
All four of you are finally here together!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They've been waiting for you, Len.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, this is the first time we're here together after that initial visit, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I think so... An and I would drop by sometimes, though.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya and I visited too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's just hard to find a day when everyone's available.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm so glad everyone's here together today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You see, there's something I've been wanting to suggest.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, why do you guys think about holding an event together with us one day?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Event?
What kind of event are we talking about here?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I haven't thought about that yet...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then why bring it up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because he wants to think about it together with us, right? Come on, that's fine!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'll take it that everyone's interested, then?
In that case, let's do something...you know? Super fun!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's too vague for me...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since we have enough people, instead of just doing a street performance, we can try to hold a proper event, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll build an outdoor stage and come up with a program...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yes, that's it! That's what I was thinking about!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You want to sing with Rin because you've made up recently, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Actually...
I was hoping we could keep it a secret from her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Can we prepare for the event without letting her know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Does that mean you intend to give her a surprise?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why I want this to be the best event ever! Something that'll surprise her and make her happy!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, please! Will you help me with this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: An event especially for your partner, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's awesome! I'm all for it. What about you guys?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've never planned for an event before, but I'd love to give it a go. I want to prepare for the event together with Len!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I think this sounds very interesting too.
What about you, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, Len's been pretty good to us, so...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll help. But I won't accept anything half-hearted if this is going to be the greatest event ever, understand?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Of course! Thanks so much, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, let's start brainstorming right away!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Miku! KAITO!
Are you here?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's weird.
They were just here a minute ago.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Still, this place sure is impressive.
There are strange things everywhere. There's even a flying train.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? What's that walking this way?
Is that a stuffed animal?

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line: Hi there! You must be a new guest!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa! You can talk!
Hey, do you know where I can find Miku and KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line:
Troupe leader KAITO and Miku?
Sure! Follow me!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's with that flower?

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line:
Oh, she's a very talented singer!
Why don't you say hello?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hello there, Ms. Flower.
I love your singing!

rows.Speaker: Singing Flower
rows.Line:
～♪
Hm?

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line:
This is our new guest.
I'm taking him to see Troupe Leader KAITO and Miku.

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line:
I see! She wants to help show you the way.
Do you mind if she comes along?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You're going to help me find Miku and KAITO?
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line: Alright, let's go find Troupe Leader KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Len!
Hi ho!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Welcome, Len! It's great to see you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hi ho, KAITO, Miku!
So I heard the one who made this SEKAI was able to find his true feelings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right. He was finally able to remember the important memories that he'd forgotten.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's great. I wish I could have come visit sooner. I would have helped you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you come all this way just to see this SEKAI, Len? It's so much fun, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! It sure looks that way! Everyone's really nice, too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I sure hope I can meet the one who created this place soon.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I think you'll get along really well.
He's really passionate about getting others to smile.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
I want to sing together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I understand how important the songs born in this place are to us, but there's no need to be in a hurry.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: He's not here today, is he?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry, but I haven't seen him.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, that's too bad.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You really can't wait to meet him, can you?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know. KAITO, why don't we put on a show for Len while we wait for everyone to arrive?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You'd do that for me?!
I'd love to see one!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: With that kind of enthusiasm, I couldn't possibly refuse. Very well, then! Let's give Len a show!

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line: You're doing a show! I want to join!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Of course!
We can all be part of the show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, let the show begin!
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Wow! This is amazing!
Miku and KAITO are like completely different people up there!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(I'd love to be part of a show like this!
I wonder if they'd let me give it a try!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What did you think of the performance, Len?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's was great! The song and dance was really cool, too! Everyone looked so dazzling!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehehe! Thanks, Len!
I'm glad we could put a smile on your face!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
KAITO! Miku!
Could I join your troupe?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm happy to hear you liked it, but what makes you want to join us?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your performance was so moving! It made me want to be a part of something so special! Please! What do you say?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I say yes☆ We have no reason to say no!
Right, KAITO?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Of course.
Although, there's one thing I want you to promise me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Creating performances is a lot of hard work.
They aren't something you can do on your own.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I want you to promise you'll remember that great shows rely on everyone working together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Got it! I promise I'll remember!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wonderful. Just be careful.
It can be easy to lose sight of what's most important from time to time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Many people get discouraged. Do you think you can push through to the end even when things get tough?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Good answer.
In that case, welcome to the troupe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hurray! We've got a brand new member!
We're gonna have lots of fun, Len☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for having me!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe. I can't wait to start making shows together!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I think I want to try coming up with a show like KAITO and the others do, but this time I'll make it on my own!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The only problem is, I'm not sure where to start.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I should probably decide what kind of things I want in the show first. What sounds like it'd be fun?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO's shows are usually a story with singing and dancing. I just need an idea that the audience will enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm... This is harder than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's the most important thing for a show? Maybe I should start with the script? Or maybe choosing parts? Oh, costumes are really important too.

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line:
Len! You look like you're working hard.
Let us know if there's anything we can do to help!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I will, thanks!
Actually, there was something I wanted to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm trying to figure out everything I need to make a good show. Is there anything you can think of other than the script and costumes?

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line: Hm... Have you thought about stage props?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, stage props!
I completely forgot about that.

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line: There's also stage lighting, any mechanical props you might need... Oh, and music too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hrng...
This is going to take even more prep work than I thought...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I think I'm getting a good overall picture, though.
Let me give it some more thought.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for the suggestions!

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line: Sure! Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Backgrounds, lighting, production, music...
Then there's the script, costumes, and casting... So much to do...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Making a show sure isn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: For the audience, the show goes by before you realize it, but the time it takes to prepare could be a hundred times as long as that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wonder if I can do something this tough on my own...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Probably not...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do you think you can push through to the end even when things get tough?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, I nearly forgot!
I promised I'd see things through to the end no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I really don't think I can do this on my own. What am I going to do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Creating performances is a lot of hard work.
They aren't something you can do on your own.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I want you to promise you'll remember that great shows rely on everyone working together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You can't make great shows on your own...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh!
This must be what KAITO meant when he said that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I can't take everything on myself.
Alright! I should find Miku and KAITO and ask them for—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hi ho, Len☆
Working hard?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You seem to be struggling with something.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Miku?! KAITO?!
What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We heard from the stuffed animals that you were working hard on a show, so we came to check on you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How's it coming?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Well, I don't think I can do this on my own.
I was just going to find you two and ask for your help!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We'd love to help!
Do you have an idea of what kind of show you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm just not really sure where to start...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
In that case, let's get everyone here!
If we all work together, we'll be done in no time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAITO, look! We finished another costume!
What do you think?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It looks great.
Can I get you to start on the main character's costume next?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure! We'll get right on it!

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line:
The stage props are finished!
How does this look?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow! It's just like I imagined!
Do you think you could lighten the sky just a bit?

rows.Speaker: Plushie
rows.Line: I'll see what we can do!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I wasn't getting anywhere trying to do this on my own. Now that everyone's helping, though, things are going so fast.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (It's way more fun coming up with ideas as a group than it was struggling to find ideas on my own, too!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So this is what it means to make a show together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO. You told me before that you can't make a great show by yourself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I remember. That's one of the first things I told you when you joined the troupe.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think I finally understand what you meant!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that.
I always believed you'd realize it sooner or later.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I have everyone here to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright! Let's all make this show a huge success together!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heya!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're here...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You turned up at just the right time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
MEIKO's working on a new menu item...
Parfaits.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: P-Parfaits?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would you like to try them?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! We absolutely do!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Great! I'll make you one right away... Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was planning on making the trial parfaits only for myself and Miku, so I don't have enough ingredients for four.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Make ours a half-size, then Len and Rin can have some too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But... Half a parfait won't be enough for me...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
We can compete for a whole one!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? We're gonna fight for a parfait?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! The winner gets an entire parfait, Len. Are you game?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sure, sounds good! But don't come begging me for a bite of my parfait when I win!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't be so cocky!
How should we do this?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We could do a Hanetsuki battle like before.
Do you still have everything, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I do, but we're out of ink.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We only need the paddles and a shuttle!
Alright, Rin. Winner gets the parfait!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Let's go outside!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha... Since I'm trying out a new menu item, I'd prefer it if everyone got to try a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Well, you go make the parfaits.
I'll be the judge.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.
Avenue

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright then, five points to win.
Sound good?

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's get... Started!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Here we go!
Haaah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ah...! Len, that's too fast!
I can't get...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One point for Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe! Say goodbye to the parfait! It's gonna be all mine!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Grrr...! Not so fast!
I'm ready for the next one!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay! Here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh... It flew up so high!
I can't even see it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe! That's because it's BEHIND you♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whaaat?! When did it get there...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One point for Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hah! Power's not the only thing you need for this game!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'll devour that parfait in front of you,
all by myself!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Okay... Next, fake right and go left...
No, Rin might see that coming...
What if I fake twice and...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hah, I knew you'd hit it to the right!
You're an open book to me, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You're clever, I'll give you that!
But you're in trouble now! Here it goes!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Looks like he's going to hit it with everything he has again. In that case, I should retreat further back!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Gotcha...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No...! A drop shot?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice fake.
Len wins!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sigh... I lost!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It was a good match, though!
Let's do it again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure, and I promise I won't lose next time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Since Len won the match, he gets the parfait as well!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right... I forgot that's what this whole match was about.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Um... It was my idea, and we agreed that the winner gets the entire parfait... It's not a big deal, I didn't want it that much anyways...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Aww, she looks so disappointed...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But man...! That was an intense match!
I'm parched!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll have to ask MEIKO for some juice. But if I drink a glass of juice, I won't have enough room for a whole parfait.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It'd be a waste to just throw half of it away...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Then I guess I'll just have to help you finish it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright! Deal!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You two...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, a juicy slice of peach!
Dibs!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't dig it out like that, Len.
You'll make the ice cream fall out!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm glad you're having fun, but don't forget that this is a taster session. I need your honest reviews!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We haven't forgotten!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hi, guys! It's been a while...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Should I get you your usual?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, what have you been up to this whole time?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Same thing as always. I've been practicing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it's been kind of hard to find a good time to meet up being New Year's and all...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why? You don't spend New Year's together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, it's a family thing for us.
And everyone's with their own family.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. My family got together for a traditional New Year's brunch.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What sort of stuff did you eat?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, it's lots of different things that are supposed to bring you good luck for the new year.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For example, black soybeans, which are supposed to help you study more diligently.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And kelp rolls for starting off on a good roll.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hahaha. They're all just silly puns?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: New Year's traditions are so funny!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What else did you do for New Year's?
Tell us all about it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, we paid a visit to a local shrine, and then we went to the Phoenix Wonderland to take some pictures.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, you went to an amusement park to take pictures? What about riding roller coasters and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. They do special New Year shows and parades, and they have a different theme every year. They're really spectacular and photogenic!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane and her dad are really into photography.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Aww. It's so sweet that you share a hobby with your dad!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It can be nice, but I hate it when my dad starts taking pictures of ME taking photos of something else!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But isn't that because he loves you that much?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wait., come to think of it...
Isn't your dad like that too, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Um, well... I'm sure he loves me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An, tell us about how your family celebrated the New Year!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, we have our cafe, so we only do family stuff on New Year's Day since we're open again right after that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Our friends, as well as some of the regulars, come by to wish us well and stuff, so you could call that our family tradition.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, that's nice! It sounds so heartwarming!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that's nice! Akito, how about you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't do anything special. I was at home for the entire holiday just chilling and practicing singing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
But it's New Year's!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was better than the other times when my sister forced me to go shopping with her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks to Akiyama, I didn't have to go this time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah.
Mizuki's friends with your sister, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's right. They went to all the New Year's sales together, so I got a breather.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: New Year's sales?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. You know, to celebrate reopening for the new year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Lots of places do grab bags too, which are supposed to be cheaper than buying stuff normally, but you don't know what you're gonna get.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito was complaining to me earlier about how his sister made him line up to get grab bags every day last year, and how she made him carry everything she bought.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. And all I got in return was a lousy lunch...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you've gone shopping with her every year until now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He complains about his sister, but still tries to make her happy...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Exactly...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Enough about me...
Your turn, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me? Well, Akito invited me to visit a shrine.
After that, we practiced together...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But other than that, I just did my assignments for the winter break.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right, homework...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Have you guys not finished yet?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Finished? I haven't even started...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you going to be okay? School starts again next week!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: S-Sure, I can do it! I'll do something about it this weekend...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah. I know...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Say, Rin. Aren't you glad we don't have homework?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But your New Year's customs sound like a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is there anything else you can tell us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I want to hear more about how you celebrate the New Year!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. Would you like to hear about the shrine An and I visited?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Or we could tell you about the shooting gallery at a New Year's fair!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa, a shooting gallery! What's that?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Tell us! Tell us!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heya, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: As promised, we've come to help!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two.
Especially with Miku off today.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We've done this a little before, so you can count on us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What do you need help with today, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Mostly table service, like taking orders.
Also, bringing out everyone's drinks.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And here are some notepads for jotting down orders...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, one more thing.
Kohane likes to order toppings,
so be sure to ask her which ones she'd like.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Our first customer!
Let's go greet her, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello, Len, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh, this is pretty rare.
You're helping out today instead of Miku?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's right!
Let us know when you're ready to order!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, I'll just have the usual.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's the blend for Akito and the dark roast for Toya, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nice. You remembered!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You come here every day, so of course I know!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An, Kohane, are you ready to order too?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'll have the blend too.
What about you, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Today, I'll have... Hot chocolate.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You got it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Psst, Rin! Don't forget to ask...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Kohane, would you like any toppings for that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, sure... Marshmallows, please.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Mmm, aren't those yummy!
Hot chocolate with puffy marshmallows is heavenly!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Hey, you two...
What do you do after taking orders?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, shoot!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We'll bring them to you right away!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Phew, I finished cleaning the tables.
How are you doing, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm done polishing the tableware, so I just need to put the cups and saucers away now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, let me help you with that.
Pass them to me and I'll put them up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay♪ Let's start with these...
They go on the second shelf from the bottom right behind you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Here, right? Okay, next...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This one and this other one go on...
The shelf that's right at your eye level.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay, here?
Hmm. It's a little high...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is there a stool you could...? I guess not...
Can't you just stand on your toes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I can try and... There, done!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, these cups and saucers have to go on that shelf over there.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, got it...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ahhh, no! That might've hit the other cups...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? Th-They didn't break, did they?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Umm... The one I was holding is fine but...
The others might not be...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len and Rin, are you finished?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: MEIKO, I'm so sorry, but I, um... I was trying to put a cup on this shelf and...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that might be hard for you two to reach...
Don't worry, I'll take care of those.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nice work today. You were a big help!
I hope you'll be up for it again sometime.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I need to get ready for tomorrow now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: R-Right. See you tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The cup I handed MEIKO was in one piece...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I hope the other one on the shelf was okay...
The next day

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hello, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're back!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hey, there! Thank you for helping out yesterday.
What can I get you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... I'd like milk tea, please.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And I'll have coffee as usual!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
One milk tea and one coffee.
Now, which cups should I use today...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh no... Rin, she's looking at the cups on THAT shelf...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But maybe nothing got broken after all...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Humhumhum♪ Humhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She would've immediately noticed if a cup was broken or cracked, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
Yes.

rows.Line: Alas, it is as you say. That particular goal has been fulfilled...

rows.Line: But then, it dawned on me that I simply wished to control Elphegort myself.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
This again?
You never change, your Highness.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Your desires know no bound. Be it wanting more treats or the moon. And you wastefully toss aside everything that you come to dislike.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
(I have always obeyed her.
I was convinced that this was the only way to make her happy.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (And now, my father and first love are both gone...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (But I cannot allow things to stay their course. If they do, this land, and you will...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Your Highness, you must withdraw your troops at once. If you do not...

rows.Line: Hm? If I do not...?

rows.Speaker: Allen

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
Nonsense, Allen!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: And what has gotten into you all of a sudden?! What is the meaning of all this?!

rows.Line: Quite a lot happened after that, but Riliane eventually agreed to my demands and called it a “special favor”.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Even after talking back to her, she let me remain by her side.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: I felt needed.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: And it genuinely made me feel happy...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: The war would end and Riliane would be saved from her fate.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Or so I thought.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: In the end, it was all too late.

rows.Speaker: Rebels
rows.Line:
“Hear our anger!!”
“End her reign of evil!!”

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Just as the Elphegort campaign ended, the rebels rose up...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: And I...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: I was captured...
Lucifenian Palace - Dungeon

rows.Line: (Ultimately, I couldn't stop that person's prediction from coming true.)

rows.Line: (But not everything will go as they say...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (They said that Riliane would have to pay, but I am here in her stead.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Riliane...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Please, run. Just keep running...)

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
(All these people hate me...

rows.Line: (I'm glad she doesn't have to stand here.)

rows.Speaker: Allen

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Allen

We were like, “Oh, it's over...”
But we had goosebumps everywhere because we just knew that we'd seen something absolutely amazing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I still can't really believe how good it was, and it really opened my eyes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It did?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. That video told me that I need to do more.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Akito and the others are trying to surpass that, which is obviously going to be an impossibly hard challenge.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know that just wanting to sing with everyone won't be enough now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't get to see that video, but the fact is that Kohane's been improving at a daunting pace.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which is why we need to do more to keep up with her and the others.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, so we want to learn more from you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Just trying something for a day or a few days won't cut it! We want to do more! A lot more!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Please, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We also promise to adjust our own practice schedules since we know we're asking a lot from you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's clear to me that you're serious about this...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So yes, I'll agree to help.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Can we start today?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, wait...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's still a chance that MEIKO's done working on that new dessert I mentioned earlier.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we stop by her place for a quick break first?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Were you really listening to anything we were saying just now, KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Of course. We can start...
Tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, way! That means you're not gonna help us at all!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We know that you're a complete slob when it comes to anything not related to music!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're starting right now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The cafe can wait until after we're done!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha... It's like I'm the student now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Enough talk! Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, okay.
We can start right now.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Talk about a busy day.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I'm really glad they were able to pull together and keep that show going.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa might be home by now...
I think I'll go see if he is.
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I'm here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Oh, good. He's already home.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Great show today, Tsukasa!
You really put a smile on everyone's faces at the end!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Len!
Apologies for leaving you hanging for so long.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<That's fine! I got to see a fun show in return♪
More importantly...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I got a great idea for White Day♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You do?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! What if...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <W-W-Wah! Something's vibrating!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sorry, Len!
I think someone's calling me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? This number...
It must be my handler from the Chocolate Factory.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Why do you think they're calling?
Anyway, I'll head back in for now!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, if you don't mind.
I'll let you know once I'm done with this call.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yay! I'm back!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Again, Len, I'm sorry about that.
Can you pick up where you left off?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<You don't have to apologize.
By the way, did they mention why they called you?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They liked the way our show went so much that they wish to incorporate the part we ad-libbed into their shows moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <The ad-libbed part...? You mean when the Choco Maniac makes chocolates for Chocota?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, precisely!
The visitors from that day have been mentioning online how much they liked that part.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Some have apparently been asking if they'd be doing that again.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa, that's amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I wasn't sure how things would go at first, but all's well that ends well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To compensate, they're giving me an opportunity to make my own chocolate!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Wait, really?!
That's perfect!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Remember how everyone shared the chocolates they made with you after the show?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
I... I don't know what to say...!
I feel so blessed to have such wonderful juniors...!
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Waahhh!
Why are homemade chocolates so heartwarming?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That's when I thought that you should make some chocolates yourself!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I see. My own chocolates...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Incidentally, that thought also crossed my mind when I was trying the chocolates Akiyama and the others gave me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Making some myself would be a clear expression how much I appreciate someone.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Does that mean...?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes. Len, I've made my decision!
As thanks for Valentine's Day, I shall make some chocolates too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In addition, Len...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As I mentioned just earlier, the Chocolate Factory is giving me a chance to participate in their demo as thanks for what we did...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But they even said that they'll help make a brand-new chocolate mold just for me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <A brand-new one?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I still haven't heard any details surrounding that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, they mentioned something about being able to make a mold based on any rough sketch or design I bring to them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In other words, whatever I draw will come to life in chocolate form!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wait, really?! I don't believe it!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I can't either.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Although, they did say I can't do anything too outrageous. In any case, it'll be good to have a few backups ready.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now for the most important part!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Alright, lay it on me!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'd like you to come up with some designs, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Me?! Are you sure?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. You've been a huge help as of late, and were a massive source of support during that show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is but a small token of my appreciation, but what do you say?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Something I draw is gonna be brought to life... As chocolate...!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yes, I'm in! I'm definitely in!
Thank you so much, Tsukasa!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wonderful!
Let's start by coming up with what to draw!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Remember to keep chocolatey thoughts in mind as you draw yours, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Okay!
I'll go find a pen and some paper!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Len, you can come out now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh? Are we the only ones here?>

rows.Line:
Yes. The factory's closed today.
Normally, they wouldn't be holding any chocolate-making demonstrations, but they’ve made an exception for us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Some of the staff are also here to help prep all the ingredients. I believe they're doing that right now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's great!
I can't wait to see how our chocolates turn out!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wait, that reminds me! What happened to the designs we came up with?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent question!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The molds for those are right here!
These are the faces of Miku and the other, and this one is for my Pegasus!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, with pigtails, cat ears and everything! This is exactly what I drew!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa! That's the Pegasus you drew!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hm? Hold on... What happened to its wings? Also, it seems kinda flat, you know...?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They made a separate mold for the wings. I'll have to put attach them to the body later.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <A-Attach them...?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. The body's actually divided into right and left halves, so I'll have to piece those all together at the end.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Whoa...!
Your Pegasus is gonna look so awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm also looking forward to seeing how it turns out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, where to put my phone. What would be the best vantage point for you...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, the space for the extra cookware could work. This should let you watch without being noticed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How's that...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Sneakily...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, this works great! I have plenty of room to hide too!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! All we need to do now is wait for the staff to return...

rows.Speaker: Staff's Voice
rows.Line: Thank you for being so patient...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Here we go!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Time to make some absolutely amazing chocolates, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Alright, let's get started. Shall we?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Yeah, let's!)

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: In order to maximize the structural integrity and overall aesthetics of your Pegasus, it may be wise to avoid mixing in nuts or anything else.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: On the other hand, your Miku chocolates should be able to accommodate a few extra additions while still looking cute.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Len, what are your thoughts in terms of toppings?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Oh, Tsukasa trying to tell me something. What's he pointing at...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I know! He's asking which toppings I want to use! If that's the case...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(The third one from the right!
The ones that look orange!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's see... His right hand's pointing to the right, and he's holding up three fingers with his left hand...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Got it! He wants three of the rightmost topping!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? No?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I guess three fingers at once wasn't clear enough... How about this? From the right... One, two, three!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now he has his right hand pointing right with his left counting one, two, three and sliding...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now I understand! Three of the third topping from the right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hahaha! Roger, Len!
Coming right up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (No, he's so close...! Third from the right, but not three of them...!!)

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
That should be it.
Everything turned out very nicely.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: I recommend putting together the Pegasus just before you present it and leaving it as is in a safe place until then.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Understood.
Thank you very much for your time today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Len, you can come out now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Great! Nice work, Tsukasa.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I could say the same for you, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe. Making chocolates was so much fun, including our little game of charades.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that was a bit of a challenge, but you did a wonderful job of clarifying your message with each successive attempt.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Really? Thank goodness!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Now to wait for the big day!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I'm looking forward to seeing how everybody reacts.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Thanks to Tsukasa, I've been able to get a great return gift together. I have to make sure everyone loves what they get!)
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I still can't get over how strange that place was.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I only saw them for a second...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But they must've been watching over other people and their feelings from different SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That place was so pretty.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And those things wafting in the breeze... Those had to be cherry blossom petals...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
If only we could have a picnic under a tree like that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget.
The cherry blossoms around the park in my neighborhood were in bloom.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wanna try having a little picnic when it's not too crowded?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:

I'd love to go!

rows.Line: She's probably waiting for the right time for us to have our picnic, but I feel like she's doing all the work at this point. Maybe I should go ask her about it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, Len. We were just heading over to MEIKO's place. Would you like to...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Perfect timing!
KAITO, I need to borrow you for a second!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Alright, see An anywhere?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Hmm... It's too dark...

rows.Line: An, can you take my order?

rows.Line: Take mine after you're done over there!

rows.Line: You got it! I'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hmm... She seems busy.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Alright, we should probably give up for now and head back to MEIKO's place...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <No, off to our next stop!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <What?!>

rows.Line: Thanks for today.

rows.Speaker: Work Manager
rows.Line:

See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right. See you tomorrow.

rows.Line: Alright, I have some time left until the event, so I can get in some practice on my own before...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Did something flash just now...?

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: <Akito, you there? Hey, it's me!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: <I'm here as well for some reason...>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Len? KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Phew. Thanks for letting us out, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No problem, but what are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, I'm a third party here since I didn't come here of my own accord.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<What?! That's not true, KAITO!
You even said, “Oh, a picnic sounds great!”>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Picnic?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! Remember how An mentioned that the cherry blossoms by the park where you guys usually practice are in bloom right now and that we should have a picnic there when it's not too crowded?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I was hoping to ask about what day would be best!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, is that what this is about? Yes, I'd like to know as well!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, they are in bloom right now, so now might be the best time to have a picnic...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <See?! I was gonna tell An that but she seemed really busy when we went over to the cafe...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, Akito, can you take us to this park instead? I wanna see what it's like beforehand!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure. I was just about to head over to practice on my own.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Awesome! Thank you so much!>
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we're here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Oh wow! Cherry blossoms!
Look, Len, real cherry blossom trees!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I can see for myself.
Also, keep it down. We can't let anyone know that we're here.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Haha. Sorry about that.
I got a little too excited about seeing them is all.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who exactly is the younger one here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, Len, what do you think?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah, they're gorgeous.
But some branches are still covered in buds.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Probably because they're in the shadow of these buildings. It might be a while until they bloom.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Don't you think we should find some trees in full bloom if we're gonna have a picnic under them?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get how you feel...
Wanna try looking somewhere else?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Really?! Wait, what about practice...?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still have time, so we can look for a bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<You're the best, Akito!
You're coming too, right, KAITO?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Of course! I can't wait to see more cherry blossoms along with more of where you and the others live, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yay! Alright, off to our next stop!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa...! Look at all the cherry blossoms!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yes, they're lovely!
In full bloom no less.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What do you think, Len?
Does this place work?

rows.Line: <Yeah! There's cherry blossoms left and right! Miku and the others are gonna love this!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I really appreciate it, Akito!
I can't thank you enough for showing us this!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No problem. Anyway, when do you want to have this picnic?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Well, we managed to find a nice spot, so ideally before these cherry blossoms fall off their branches!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Alright, why don't we start getting everything together for it while we wait?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah!>
