rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's one of the many things I like about you. Next time you think of something, don't forget to invite me. I'd love to help out!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len, firstly, congratulations on delivering a fantastic performance. I'm glad you and Rin had a good time, despite a few hiccups along the way...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Today has definitely given me plenty of inspiration for my anniversary show! I hope you can give me a few pointers when it comes around. Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ready everyone? All together now!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe, thanks everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I may have a lot of fun ideas, but most of them would be useless if I were alone. It's the shared experience that makes them so fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So thank you everyone, for always jumping on board with my ideas!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Next time my brain hatches an idea, I'll be sure to let you all know so we can have even more fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh yes, please do!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “Huff... Huff...”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord
rows.Line:
“Why don't you submit already?
You have no hope of defeating me!”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord's Vassal
rows.Line: “Hehehe. Indeed. Do you not see how weak you are?”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line:
“I refuse to submit!
I carry the weight of the world on my shoulders! Losing is not an option!”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “For the sake of all who fought alongside me until now...”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “All those who placed their faith in me...”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “Prepare yourself!”

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: We believe in you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Yes! I nailed that line like I did during practice! That just leaves...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Now I just have to magically empower the hero so that he can defeat the Demon Lord! Get ready, Len! Here I go!)

rows.Speaker: Sorceress
rows.Line:
“Hero!
Channel our thoughts! Feel our energy coursing through...! Huh...?!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (My wand...!)

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Oh no! Her wand flew away!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(She accidentally threw it...!
What do we do?!
I'm still fighting the Demon Lord...)

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord's Vassal
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah hah!
I succeeded in disarming you of your wand!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (MEIKO...!)

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord's Vassal
rows.Line: “Now, my lord, crush this so-called hero! Show him how pathetic he truly is!”

rows.Speaker: Fairy A
rows.Line: “Nooo! That's not going to happen!”

rows.Speaker: Fairy A
rows.Line: “Everyone! Lend the Sorceress your energy!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Fairy A
rows.Line: “If we give her enough energy, she should be able to use magic without her wand!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Miku...?! Oh, she's trying to help Rin!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (You guys...)

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: You can do it, Sorceress!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: We'll give you lots and lots of our energy!

rows.Speaker: Sorceress
rows.Line:
“Thank you all so much!
With this much energy, I won't need my wand...”

rows.Speaker: Sorceress
rows.Line:
“Now, Hero!
Channel our thoughts! Feel our energy coursing through you!”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “So much power! This is incredible...! With this, I should be able to...!”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line:
“Prepare yourself, Demon Lord!
*Roar*”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord
rows.Line: “What?! Nooooo!!!”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord's Vassal
rows.Line: “Th-This cannot be! He won?!”

rows.Speaker: Sorceress
rows.Line: “Now, for disarming me of my wand, here is a little payback! Take this!”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord's Vassal
rows.Line: “Oh no!”

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: They did it! They won!

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “Thank you all very much! We couldn't have done it without you!”

rows.Speaker: Fairy B
rows.Line: “Sorceress, we found your wand and came to deliver it... Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Fairy A
rows.Line: “Haha! It's all over?”

rows.Speaker: Fairy B
rows.Line: “What?! But we looked so hard for it...”

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: “Hahaha!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Geez, that was a close one...
But we managed to figure something out!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
I caused you all a ton of trouble because I messed up...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's important to learn from your mistakes, but these things happen during live performances.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. If anything, I'd like to praise everyone for the wonderful ad-libbing they just did.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
Because shows are a team effort♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Exactly! Rin, you even threw in a good line when you zapped MEIKO in the end there!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, you did! I liked that one very much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anyway... I feel pretty tired, so I'm gonna head back!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, Rin...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Len, no.
We should give her some space.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What happened must be bothering her quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, she practiced that part a lot since it was sort of the Sorceress's big moment...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: True. She recited that line in a very compelling manner during practice...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which may be why she's kicking herself for what happened. I agree that we should give her some space for now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I really hope Rin's okay...)
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I really hope Rin's okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (The others said that we should give her some space for now, but I'm kinda worried...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (It's okay if I go take a peek to see how she's doing, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's see... The plushies said that they saw Rin around here somewhere... Aha!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Oh no... She seems pretty sad.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (What should I do? I wanna cheer her up somehow, but I also don't want what I say to backfire...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Did someone just call my name just now?
Over here! Look this way!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, you guys were also worried and decided to see how she's doing?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry. I know I was the one who said we should give her some space...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But that didn't stop us from worrying about her. I mean, Rin's usually able to get back up on her own.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, what can we do to cheer her up?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think our best option is to redo the same show and get through it without any slipups...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... What if that makes things worse? She might try too hard and tense up or something.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right...
So, for now, let's think of a way to cheer her up directly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whenever you feel sad, it's fairly natural to fall deeper and deeper into that abyss so to speak.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What you just said...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know how easy it is to fall deeper and deeper into this sort of abyss, so I'm very worried.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, our first step may be to help cheer her up by thinking of something that she can enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, that's it...!
The same thing might work for Rin!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The same thing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What you guys just said reminded me of the time Emu was feeling really down. Remember?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! This is a pretty similar situation...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We agreed that only Emu herself can settle her own feelings, but we also agreed to help cheer her up a little in the meantime!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, and we suggested that she do something she truly loves...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Exactly! So, Rin might feel better if she does something she really loves!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Something she really loves?
Okay, let's take that and try coming up with some ideas!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? Len...? Wait, you're all here...
What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin! We're about to go on all the rides and attractions in SEKAI! Come join us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? But I...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Chugga-chugga-choo-choo!
Everyone, the train to take you on a tour of all the rides and attractions is here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A train? Not the flying one?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes! Here's how you board!
Like this!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, I'll go next. There.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, this is just...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. We're gonna pretend to be the train that takes us around!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, we'll be able to go on all the rides and attractions you love so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len... You guys...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Chugga-chugga-chugga-chugga! Choo-choo!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like our driver is raring to go.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Now, you two, come aboard.
As the conductor, I belong at the back.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay! Rin, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, we're all aboard!
Driver, take us away!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Roger! The Miku Miku Express is ready to depart! Choo-choo!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yay! Go go go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, we're gonna trip over each others' feet if we're not careful!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's try to move in rhythm! One, two! One, two!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Nice idea, Len!
Miku, steady as she goes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Choo-choo! (Okay!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha♪
Miku, you're more like the train than the driver!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Oh, Rin just laughed...!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Alright, let's keep this up and have as much fun as we can!)
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Valentine's Day, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, um... Valentine's Day is all about showing appreciation for close acquaintances and the people you care about most.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why you give chocolates to all your friends!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, it doesn't have to be chocolates. Anything is okay as long as it symbolizes your appreciation for whomever receives your gift♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Gifts for the people you care about most...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wish I could make something like Mizuki and the others...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, what if I asked the others...?
They might know of something that I can do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You want to make some gifts...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see...
As much as I'd like to help you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
There's nothing here...
You can't make anything even if you really want to.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I tried asking Rin and the others, but they all gave me the same response...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, this song...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Len.
You seem a little down...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
You also wish to make some gifts for Valentine's Day?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, but... I'm not sure if I can.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I even asked the others about this...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They all said that I can't because there's nothing here and I wouldn't be able to make anything if I wanted to.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Unfortunately...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I knew it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Len...
Why don't we try thinking about this more together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What would you like to do for Mafuyu and the others on Valentine's Day?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I thought the idea of giving gifts to those who mean most to you is really nice...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And I always have a lot of fun whenever they come over to SEKAI because they have so much to tell us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So... I want to tell them, “Thank you.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Len...
I wish I could've helped you more.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: N-No, it's okay. I'm sorry for dropping this on you so suddenly. Thanks for spending the time to think about this with me...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We may not have found a solid answer, but I think I realized something important...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Something important?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I think I really like talking to others and hearing about how they feel...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I never realized how warm things feel when you think about doing something for someone else.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku, I'm gonna keep thinking more about what I can do for them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you ever think that you need any help, feel free to ask. I'll be more than happy to help...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I will! Thanks, Miku!
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I had another look at the candles you made, Len. You really did a wonderful job.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, and the flowers in them are very cute...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I don't think any of us were expecting you to make such nice Valentine's Day gifts for us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kanade helped you make them, right...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... She came to talk to me after becoming a little worried about how I was doing...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, after I told her that I wanted to make some gifts, she suggested that we make some candles since she had some supplies left over...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you had a chance to make them, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So, it smells nice as it is...
But since it's a candle, why don't we try lighting it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade gave me some matches... But... I'm not sure how to light them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'll do it...
Where are they?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
...!
Thanks! I'll go get them now!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Someone's feeling generous today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This hardly counts as being generous.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's lit...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I love how the flame sort of dances. I could watch this endlessly.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I'm starting to smell something...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me too...
It smells refreshingly sweet.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sniff*
Hey, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mind if I take a whiff?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I could've just carried it over...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? This works just fine...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Join us, Miku.
You probably can't smell it from over there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How is it, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's such a gentle fragrance. I like it...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
They really like how it smells.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I asked Kanade how to make these...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What about you, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
I haven't actually tried smelling it yet...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, because Kanade was the one who actually made them...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Then, don't stand over there.
Come here and join in on the fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Oh, it smells like apples...
I think Kanade said this is chamomile.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I feel so much warmth welling up inside of me...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I hope the others are also feeling the same way...)
Between Worlds
Lalala♪ Lala♪ La♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? That voice... Is it Rin?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Her singing sounds so chipper. Did something good happen for her?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Lucky. I wonder if something good will happen for me...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, a fragment of a feeling!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's such a pretty color.
What kind of feeling was this born from?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I think I'll give it a touch!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hello...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa! There's a bunch of toys!
Oh, and there's a big TV over there!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What is this place? A toy SEKAI, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, it's got CDs with me and Rin on them!
Whoa, and lots of merch too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe. This place seems pretty fun, so maybe I'll take a look arou—
*Sniffle* *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? Is somebody crying...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm, I think it's coming from over here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, is somebody there?
Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (So it was this girl crying... Wait, why is there a person here?!)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh... Are you... Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa! Y-Yeah, I am...
You know about me?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah... Yu loves you, Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yu? Is that a friend of yours?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa, whoa, don't cry!
Um... I sure do wonder where we are...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I think this is a hospital, because it's kind of like the one he's in...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yu's in a hospital? Is he not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Mhm... They say he was born with a bad sickness...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see...
So, you've visited him in the hospital a lot?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Yeah... I went every day.
But... I haven't visited him since we had that fight.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A fight?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I said something awful to him...
But I don't know how to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: It's been really lonely, so today I went to sleep listening to one of your songs that he told me about.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: And then I was here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (This Yu might just be the owner of these feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (So she wandered into this place because she's related to what he's feeling...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Hmm, but this isn't a SEKAI yet, so is that really...)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Um, Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ah, yeah? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Did you see Yu?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I heard you crying right after I arrived, but... I haven't seen anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, want to go look for him together?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But... We had that fight...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, would you mind telling me about this Yu?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
He's a precious friend of yours, right?
I want to know more about him.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh! So he lives in the house across from yours.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah. When I was little, I used to play at his house all the time.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: He's always been really sick, though, so his dad would be there with us.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh yeah, Yu's dad said he used you and Rin to make songs a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, wow! Hehehe, that makes me pretty happy.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Hehe. Yu also loves you two, and he's told me about lots of wonderful songs.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: So, I want to sing your songs with him someday.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, nice! But when you say “someday”... Is that because of his illness?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah... Mom said it makes it hard for him to breathe.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I thought we would be able to go to elementary school together... But he was only there for the entrance ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So it's really serious...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
It is, and I...
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Why did you two fight?
Could you tell me?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Why did you two fight?
Could you tell me?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I wanted Yu to get better...
So I visited and sang for him every day.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Every day?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah... Yu told me that he had more energy and was even able to finish his food after hearing me sing...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
And my mom said the same thing.
She said people get more energy to fight off sickness when they're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: So I thought... Singing is so amazing...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I thought that if I did my best, I might be able to see Yu at school and sing your songs with him.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But then... Mom told me that Yu is going to a hospital overseas...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Why...?! You said that you've been getting better, that your test results were good...!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Um... Hii, I'm sor—

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: You said you feel better when I sing!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I wanted to go to school with you...!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
You're such a liar!
I... I'm never singing again!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (She must have been singing her very hardest for him all that time, making a wish in her heart...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (At the same time, I'm sure...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't think everything Yu told you was a lie.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Singing... Really does have a mysterious power. Especially singing that has strong feelings behind it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So I really don't think that he was lying about feeling better after you sang for him.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: He has to work really hard to get better, and he was getting the energy to do that from your singing.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
I had two shots today that really hurt.
But the pain went away when I heard you sing.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
I might be able to go home soon.
I'm going to do my best. So I hope you'll cheer me on with your singing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Have you seen him since your fight...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: No. I was going to apologize to him yesterday with my mom there to help. But...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: When we got to the hospital, Yu's mom was crying, and my mom went to talk to her...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: She told me to wait where I was, but I wanted to see Yu...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: So I snuck ahead and looked into his room, and...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: There were a bunch of doctors all around him, and he looked like he was really hurting...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I-I... I got scared and ran...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What happened to him then...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
He ended up okay...
But he can't get out of bed by himself anymore.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: What...do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Did he get worse...because I stopped singing?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
*Sob*
What do I do if Yu dies...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! I-It's okay! I'm sure it'll be okay.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
And I'm also sure that Yu is still doing his best right now.
You can't think like that when he's still fighting!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: *Sniffle* But...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I can't heal his sickness...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's true... But I think you can give him the power he needs to fight it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So I hope you'll make up with him, and then sing for him again.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I want to make up with him, but...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I'm afraid to see him.
What if he looks like he's hurting really badly again...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If he looks like he's hurting, then that's the most important time to sing for him.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
“I'm here for you, you can do it, you can do it.”
Pack all of your feelings into it.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Can I...do that...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Absolutely. I know you can!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This dream you're in right now... It's one you can only have if your feelings are very strong.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, I know for a fact how strong your feelings are!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Okay... Thank you, Len.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But am I going to be able to apologize well...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Are you worried? Well then...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe. My gift of courage to you!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Your hands are so warm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right? If you get scared or feel unsure of yourself, just think of me.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Okay...
I think I can give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh... That's right. I need to practice singing a lot. I want him to get lots and lots of energy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ooh, great! That's the spirit, that's the spirit!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... It looks like it's time to say goodbye.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Okay... I wanted to talk to you a lot more, but... I have to go see Yu.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right! Okay then, I'll give you one last cheer!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Go, go, go! Hi-na-tsu!
You can do it, you can do it, Hi-na-tsu!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh! My name...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'll be cheering you both on from here!
I believe that your wish will come true...!
Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wonder how things turned out for those two...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, she smiled at the end, so I'm sure they're fine.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I hear Rin. Sounds like she's singing again... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But this singing sounds kind of rough...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... This voice is...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's right...! Yu's dad had experience making songs with us, didn't he?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, this Rin that's singing must be...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm glad they were able to make up!
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I hope Kanade and the others visit today...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Including Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I heard that she hasn't been able to work on their music with the others lately...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(But she must be feeling so lonely...
If she could just come over here to where Miku is...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: H-Hello, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do I do...?
Should I try talking to him...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: U-Um, so...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I think someone just came...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looks like it...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Is it them?
I hope Mafuyu's also here.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Oh, wait... The other day, Mafuyu and KAITO sort of...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, come on. Open your eyes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know exactly what she's trying to do. But you just keep—

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No... No...! Mom... She...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (If Mafuyu and KAITO see each other again...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: W-Wait, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I-If Mafuyu is with them...
Please try not to say anything mean to her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Mean?
I was only telling her what she needed to hear.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey...! W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Mafuyu was so distraught last time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Because you lot have been babying her too much...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: At this rate, nothing is going to change. Do you plan on extending her suffering?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, I don't want that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But...!
D-Does it really have to be now...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Kanade and the others...
They said that it's been over a week since they last worked with Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Making music with the others meant so much to her...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But she must be in so much pain since she can't even do that now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So...
Telling her now to “open her eyes” seems...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All I'm saying is...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mafuyu isn't here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len, let go of me...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... S-Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So, MEIKO...
Who's here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Kanade. She wants to hear what we think of her new song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They also mentioned that they'll be throwing an after-party to celebrate their new song being uploaded. Mafuyu's supposed to go...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She is...? That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, Len, you seem to really dislike the thought of Mafuyu feeling any pain...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? I mean, it never feels good...
And my chest always gets so cold...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I also get that feeling bad for her won't actually make her feel any better...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Obviously...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Does that mean I'll never really be able to help her...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe that's entirely up to you, Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Mafuyu herself likely doesn't know...
But myself and the others are all here because she wished it so as the owner of these feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, how we interact with her is a different story. As such, our specific roles aren't quite so clear...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nonetheless, Len, I believe you should do as you please. Like how you stopped KAITO earlier.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We don't have to all agree...?
Shouldn't we work together to help...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you think we can?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, I think it's better if we don't agree...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Us, this SEKAI...
We were called here at a time when Mafuyu was about to lose herself.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which is why I feel that we should all just be ourselves and maintain our individuality.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Be ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Maintain our individuality...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, who does that make me...?
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Us, this SEKAI...
We were called here at a time when Mafuyu was about to lose herself.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which is why I feel that we should all just be ourselves and maintain our individuality.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me as an individual...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (MEIKO said that our specific roles are all different regarding this...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Isn't there something you can do because you're the way you are?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You say that you're not capable of helping her...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I believe there's something you can do specifically because you ran from everything until now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I couldn't do anything to help when Mizuki seemed to really need it.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But Luka helped Mizuki realize something really important after giving a small piece of advice...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (What she did was so amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Was Luka able to do that because she understands who she is as a person?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, what's with all the weird nodding...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wah...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Rin... You scared me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Your shouting scared me...
Also, you didn't answer my question.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, um... I was just thinking about something...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay? What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, please don't laugh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You as an individual...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I've been having trouble getting my head around that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, you're just you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Len, there you are♪
Heya, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hi, Mizuki.
What brings you here today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Remember that talk we had the other day? I brought a Swiss roll as thanks for that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh...? But I didn't do...
Luka was the one who gave you that advice...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you're trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you gave what I said a lot of serious thought, Len. I really appreciate that and want to thank you for putting in the effort.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Because I thought so much about it...?
Did I do that because that's who I am as a person...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about you, Rin? Since you're here, you're more than welcome to have some of this Swiss roll!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure, it's not like I have anything else to do.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Great! Then let's go find Luka!
Actually, before we do...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Len, you don't look all that happy.
Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, I'm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: He was worrying about who he is as a person or something. I dunno. Ask him.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ah, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Who you are as a person...?
That's getting pretty philosophical.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, MEIKO explained earlier how she believes we should all maintain our individuality...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I sort of don't really know what makes me who I am...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I see...
Hmm... Maintaining your individuality...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Why not try thinking about your traits or personality? That might make things easier.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: My traits and personality...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
For example, Len...
Whenever you talk to anyone, you always do your best to understand how they're feeling!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is that what makes me...me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: At the very least, I think so.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's easy for people to play or have fun together, but not many are willing to put so much serious thought into how others or their friends feel.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The kindness you show Len is something that's pretty unique to you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: See? Even after we talked the other day and I left to go back to my room...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know what I have to do now, so I'm gonna try getting a hold of Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have no idea if this is gonna go well, but I'll just have to see what happens.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, good luck.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
U-Um.... Mizuki?
Would you mind waiting for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, it's about this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, hey... Those are the ribbons I brought over when I was thinking about doing Miku or Rin's hair.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah... Would you mind sitting for me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I hope this'll help you get your message across...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you've tied such a lovely bow...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, and you made a nice choice!
You have good taste, Len.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I feel all amped up and good to go! I promise to do my best! Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think the kindness you showed that time is a great representation of who you are, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I see... And that alone is something...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Are you two done talking?
Let's go find Luka already...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Right!
Let's go, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay...!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: When you and I talked, you said schoolwork might be a challenge... Does this mean you know what you're gonna do about that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... Not exactly since I won't know how a lot of things go until I actually give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I've just gotta do the best I can!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. In any case, it's nice to hear that you're all looking forward to being in the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, you two!
That means you really gotta have fun during the time you have left as regular high schoolers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, we will!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Len, you look a little sad...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, no... It's nothing, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was just thinking that I don't really know anything about the girls' school...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Their school?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: For example, Minori said how getting her homework and stuff done is gonna be really hard...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I'm having trouble imagining how hard that'll actually be...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When you put it that way, I can't really imagine it either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When it comes to being an idol, you can practice singing and dancing or watch DVDs of past shows to see what kinds of effects might be good...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. I remember Minori saying how math and English are really hard...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But the only thing I really got is that she has to use a lot of brainpower for those subjects...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What about their actual school?
Have they ever told you what it's like?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Uhh... There's only girls!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. It is an all-girls high school after all.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I think I remember someone saying that they're given tests a little more often compared to other schools.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also, the fact that they have a credit-based course...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It apparently makes it easy for students to attend while working in show business.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, there's also the Sports Festival, School Festival, choir recital and lots of other school events...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I believe that's about all we know.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So you feel that way too...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wanna learn more about what they're like as students...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think I'll go see for myself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If I don't go now, I might never get another chance to see what the girls are like as normal students.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, I know I should've done this sooner, but I'm gonna go see what they're like at school.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
It is important to always learn new things♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, wanna ask the others to see if they'll join us?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I think MEIKO and Luka are practicing together right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO's probably working on the schedule for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, let's split up and go get them!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We can head over to the girls' school once we've all gathered.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Okay♪
Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: That's all for today's class.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's lunchtime!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?! Sh-She's already gone...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe she has lunch practice again...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I think it's a good thing that she's so hungry. It's a sign that she's happy and motivated!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I wonder what she'll be having for lunch.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Haha...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
What...? Minori, you're back already?
That was so fast!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I want to spend as much time as possible with everyone during lunch today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, wanna eat together?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Sure. While we're at it, should we invite a few others?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, let's!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, wanna have lunch with us?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line:
Mind waiting for one more?
She's grabbing something to eat now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No problem!
Oh...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Are you two about to have lunch?!
Wanna join us?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Really? Then, we'll bring our lunches over now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
Minori's really full of energy.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho, Kohane!
You two should join us too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sure... Wait, hold on...
How many people did you invite...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Everyone who was still in the classroom!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, we have two more joining us!
Please try to make some room for them if you can!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Is there room on your side?

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Yeah, one sec!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Hinomori! Azusawa!
You two can sit here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is incredible! Our desks are all together like lunchtime during elementary school!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
I couldn't put my finger on it, but I knew this felt nostalgic somehow!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Alright, I think we all have a seat.
Minori, let's start eating!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, everyone! Put your hands together and...!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Haha! We're really doing this?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Minori has so many friends.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah, and they're all really into it!
They brought their desks together and were even nice enough to make room for more people♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, your fruit sandwiches look really good!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Here, have a bite.
In return, Hanasato, I get to try your bread.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. They look like they're having so much fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, it's such a heartwarming scene.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <People really seem to gravitate toward Minori...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, you're right.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <She's very open with her feelings, so I can see why others would have no trouble reciprocating.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Friends really are a wonderful thing to have.>
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Come to think of it, the girls are officially pros now, right? What does that mean for them moving forward?

rows.Line: Wait, we should totally do something to cheer them on! Something that'll really pump them up!

rows.Line: Cheering them on seems fine, but what do you mean by “pumping them up”...?

rows.Line: You know...?

rows.Line: Miku-P, help!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (And they're only gonna get busier as they get ready to debut.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (If anything, that's pretty much when they'll really start working as professional musicians...)

rows.Line: Len? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Nothing's wrong...

rows.Line: But I just realized that the girls are gonna be working even harder as musicians now that they're pros.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, that's very true.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, why don't we do something for them that'll encourage them to do their best as pros moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:

We could put on a really amazing show for them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A show for them?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I bet it will get them excited about their future if we really put our minds to it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Just like how they lit this fire inside of me through their show!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! That's such an amazing idea!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm all for it.
A show does sound more fun than playing some games with them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, you don't have to be that brutally honest.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm for it as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree with Len that a show seems like the best way to motivate the girls.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just forget about those, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're gonna put on a super awesome show that gets the girls really excited about their future!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm back in my own SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:

rows.Line: I've been wanting to meet you for the longest time! You're such a great guitarist, you're mature and you're so cool!

rows.Line: So, let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm cool?

rows.Speaker: Len

rows.Speaker: Len

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Sort of...

rows.Line: Why'd you go wandering off like that, Len?! What's the big idea?!

rows.Line: If we don't hurry, the ice cream Ichi and the others brought over is all gonna melt!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm sorry.
I was just getting some fresh air.

rows.Line: But, you guys could've just started without me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, that'd be like us leaving you out on purpose! We wouldn't do anything so mean!

rows.Speaker: Len

rows.Line: Anyway, now that we're all here, let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What choices do we have?

rows.Line: Haha. I bet I know who chose these for us.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Len

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Since I'm gonna be on vocals for this show, I need to put on a really cool performance for them.)

rows.Line: <I'm working with Rin and the others to get ready and make this a fun show, so look forward to it!>

rows.Line: As it turns out, we've received lots of messages from people who say they cannot wait for the show!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: <Yeah! It's great how they can get enjoyment not just from the day of the show, but in this lead-up time too!>

rows.Line: <Plus, I bet it'll be really exciting for them if any of their predictions come true!>

rows.Line: Indeed. Any of you who'll be attending the show, why not give this a try with your friends and loved ones?

rows.Line: <Thanks to everybody who bought tickets! I'm looking forward to seeing you!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <And everybody who wasn't able to, don't worry. We actually have livestream and remote screening options too.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: That means you'll be able to watch the show from your neighborhood movie theater or even the comfort of your own home!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Right! So to everybody who was fretting about not being able to make it to Shibuya, don't you worry.>

rows.Line: It's nice that there are so many ways to take part. We even got this response in a street interview.

rows.Line: Good afternoon! You seemed quite invested in taking photos of this Rin and Len poster for the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show.

rows.Line: So that's why you were taking so many pictures. I hope your friend likes them.

rows.Line: It seems that, despite being hospitalized abroad, the friend of the girl I spoke to will be able to watch one of your livestreams with her.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Using such communication tools, we can enjoy chatting with friends as if they're right by our sides.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe. I've gotta do my best to make sure she and her friend both have lots of fun!>

rows.Line: Well unfortunately, that's about all the time we have.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
Thank you for joining us today, Len.

rows.Line: <Great! I'm gonna do my best to make this show enjoyable for everyone, whether you're at the venue, attending a screening or watching the stream!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, right at this moment, people all around the world are watching our show!

rows.Line: It's evening in Shibuya right now, but for people on the other side of the globe, it's the middle of the day, right?

rows.Line: In fact, there may be some people watching this later at night, or very early in the morning.

rows.Line: Whoa...! If it was the middle of the night for me, would I actually be able to stay up until the show started...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, I get that, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure some people watching our show right now did stay up late or wake up incredibly early for us.

rows.Speaker: Len

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're able to sing at such an incredible venue because you all listen to our songs.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're gonna keep pumping up the heat so even all of you beyond the screen can feel it!

rows.Line:

Welcome!

rows.Line: Huh...? Kohane and An aren't with you?

rows.Line: Nah. We're just here to catch a break before practice starts.

rows.Line: Are you helping MEIKO out today, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:

rows.Line: I'll have my usual.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Line: Okay, just give me one moment!

rows.Line: MEIKO! Akito and Toya are heeere!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
This one's for you, Toya!
Here's yours, Akito, and feel free to use this milk and sugar!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Great, thanks... Huh?
What's with the orange juice...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's mine. MEIKO said I can take a break until our next customer comes in!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, is it cool if I join you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. There's something I've been wanting to ask you guys!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ask us?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. So, you're supposed to be moving up a year soon, right? I heard a bunch of stuff is supposed to change, but what's actually gonna happen?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's gonna happen...? We're gonna be second-years, and our classes will be different too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, I know that much...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'm not talking about that!
I wanna hear something like... Something you don't think I'd know!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Even then, I don't really know what else to tell you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As far as things that will change in the new school year, I suppose it would be getting new textbooks and having juniors at school.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, the part about getting juniors sounds interesting!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, so how do you feel about getting juniors?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How do I feel...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't know, to be honest.
In junior high, I couldn't even interact with people in my own year much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But now I'm a bit excited.
I think I'll finally get to feel like I have juniors.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ooh, nice!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're nice and really smart, Toya, so I bet your juniors will rely on you a whole lot!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I would be happy to be that reliable senior.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
How about you, Akito?
How do you feel about getting juniors?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well... I think for me, it kinda feels like I'm getting more friends.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Friends? Not like, lackeys who'll do whatever you say or something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look here, you...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hahaha, c'mon, I'm kidding!
So, what else?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel like the juniors I've interacted with the most were the ones on my soccer team...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we had our coach, so I wasn't doing stuff like teaching them or looking after them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So that's what you meant by feeling like they're friends instead of juniors...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But aren't the juniors the ones who put away all the equipment and clean up the field and all that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, I guess it works that way in a lot of places.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I usually helped them.
Cleanup finished faster that way, and they'd stay back to do extra practice with me, so.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Huh, you were actually a good senior, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's nothing to call me a good senior over.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You think so? I figure you're a good senior just for not acting all high and mighty!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm, I'd like to be the junior to a senior like you guys!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm happy to hear you say so.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But are you okay with that? You won't be able to bite back at us if you're our junior.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's totally fine!
I mean, I bet you'd treat me nicer as your junior, and help me out with anything I ask!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's got you there, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
He's real sly when it comes to this kinda thing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um, an incredible practice...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We don't wanna get left behind Kohane and the others! So tell us some incredible practice we can do!

rows.Line:
Hm...

rows.Line: Shouldn't it be fine? I don't think you need to do anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:

We're serious about this!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, what she said!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Owww!
