rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Sorry, my bad.
I shouldn't have started with the conclusion like that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: First off, what was it that made you want to do some incredible practice?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Like we already said, we figure Kohane and the others must be doing that sort of practice with An's dad.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Uh-huh. And so, you felt that you didn't want to get left behind, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmmm, so that's the part I don't really get...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What makes you think you're going to get left behind if you don't do some incredible practice?

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I-I mean...
Since Kohane and the others are doing some incredible stuff, I figured...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Practice is supposed to be for learning to do things you can't do, and improving at the things you can, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Kohane and the others have things they should be learning and improving on...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And so do the two of you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But if you don't know what those things are yourselves, don't you think whatever practice you end up doing will be useless?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right... I kinda thought doing some crazy practice would make us improve, but that's the wrong way to look at it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What is it that you can do, and what is it that you're lacking...
It'll be better if you can focus on thinking about those things first.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you feel like it'll be tough to think that through on your own, I'll help you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You will?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y'know, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sometimes you feel like a real teacher!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, that's 'cause I am your teacher!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Where'd Rin get to?
She said she wanted to come up with some stage effects together...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Heeey, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh... Welcome back, everyone.
Wait, what?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, you guys. I didn't know you were with them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sorry!
They said they had something really important to tell us...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Something really important?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's right!
Now that we're all here, let's tell them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is so exciting. I can't wait to hear.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, we'd like to announce...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That we're gonna be on TV!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow...! Another offer for TV! That's incredible!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah, things have going so well lately for you. How many shoots is this now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, all the hard work you put in is really starting to pay dividends.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It's great to see that you're finding so much success.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we still have room to do more! After all, our next goal is to do a show at the Butokan!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right! I hope this next program gets even more people interested in MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sounds like you all have plenty of motivation.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But please be careful not to push yourselves too hard with such a busy schedule.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, we will!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, we're going for a shoot and some R&R, so we should have plenty of time to relax.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A shoot and some R&R?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! We're gonna check in at a nearby inn the day before the shoot!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow, that sounds so nice!
What's the inn like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's called Ryusuiso.
Just give me one second... Ah, this is it. Can you all see?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh my gosh! It has its own hot spring?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fantastic!
Speaking of which, I remember hearing that inns with hot springs also usually have table tennis. Is that true for this inn...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?! That sounds super fun!
So you could all play against each other if you wanted?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It could be fun to break into pairs and have a doubles tournament.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Who do you think would be the best out of all of us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: KAITO and Miku seem like they'd make a strong pair. They'd probably be unstoppable once they got on a roll.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you and MEIKO would stun us with some surprising moves, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've got a pretty good feeling about Rin and me. Right, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We're not gonna let anyone beat us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Now we're all excited.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I dunno if they have table tennis... But we'll let you all know when we get there.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It shouldn't be a problem. We'd like for you to get the chance to enjoy the trip with us, especially since we're going to such a lovely place.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo! I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, hey!
Since we're going on a trip together, we should grab some outfits for ourselves from the dressing room!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree! That sounds really fun♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, can you girls give us some advice on what we should wear?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure thing!
You're gonna look absolutely adorable once we're done♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Then, let's go!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. There they go.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Still, I get why they're so excited.
It's been a while since they last got to stay over somewhere together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Plus, they've been so busy lately.
I mean, they've been working so hard.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I hope this trip ends up being really refreshing for them.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What brings you all here today, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, did you get another work offer, like the camping shoot you did recently?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Not quite that sort of news this time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We brought back some souvenirs from that camping shoot, and now we're here to give them to you all.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Souvenirs?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, here they are.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, aren't these hot spring manju?
I remember you saying that they were really good.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo! You remembered to bring some back!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Of course.
We were hoping that you'd all get a chance to try these.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When we had them, we were really surprised, so I'm sure you guys—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Surprised?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
U-Uhh, I meant...!
We were really surprised by how yummy these manju were!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we want you all to try them as soon as possible. If you want... Ahaha...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
In that case, let's have some now.
I really wanna see what they taste like.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Then, I'll start handing them out.
Here you all are.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks, Shizuku.
Alright, now that we all have one...

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There's two layers of bean paste...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: He's right! There's white bean paste on top and red bean paste on the bottom!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they're both delicious♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Just the reactions we were hoping for.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were also really surprised when we had them at the inn. Saito said that the filling was special in some way, but we weren't expecting two layers.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, right?! I thought mine was the only one like that, and I'd drawn a lucky manju and won a prize!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've seen lucky popsicles, but I've never heard of a lucky manju.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We wanted to surprise you all the same way, so we decided to keep it a secret. We're glad to see that you like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, Minori almost spilled the beans...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I-I'm really sorry!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (That explains why Minori panicked there for a second.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, to think that even the gift you brought would be hiding a surprise like this. There was never a dull moment on your trip.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Never a dull moment, huh...?
We did sort of end up doing a lot.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, we chopped wood and had to start a fire in such an unexpected way during our shoot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I didn't think we'd ever get it to start...
It's all my fault for having such terrible luck...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I thought you were really cool that time, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. You definitely made it clear that you were going to get that fire started no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We were rooting for you the entire time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You were?! Then, maybe you were the reason our fire finally started?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. It's nice to think that we might have ended up helping.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, this shoot sounds so fun since you all experienced things that you normally wouldn't. I'm somewhat curious now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She's right. I know that we probably couldn't go camping in the wilderness... But I really wanna try doing something like that, even in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Like what, for example?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hmm... Well...
For example, we could have another training camp.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A training camp?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It wouldn't exactly be a vacation, but we'd still get to experience something new and different...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, we might notice some things this time round that we couldn't before.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, Len may be right.
Doing another training camp may be a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm for it too! It sounds super fun♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That means I'll need to come up with another training regimen that pushes us all to get fitter and stronger! I wonder what to include...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO, can I help you with that?
I really wanna give it a try.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've been wondering lately if there's any way for me to help everyone.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Plus, you need to have a strong core and build up muscles in order to put on good performances. Coming up with a training regimen seems like a good place to start.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, how about it? Mind if I help out?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that case, you're more than welcome to join me. Let's come up with something that helps everyone grow even stronger, Len!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think you're going to do a great job, Len.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll be looking forward to seeing what you come up with!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You got it. I'm gonna come up with something really amazing!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
This ended up being a nice break.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, sure thing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, we should head back!
We have that meeting about the arts festival with the others!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, good luck☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then, we'll be going.
Please tell KAITO and the others we said hello.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow, an arts festival!
They both sounded really excited☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Not only that, Tsukasa's the lead with Rui as the director... I bet their play's gonna be great!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you think Nene's class is gonna do? Also a play? Oh, what if they sang as a chorus or something...?!
You all seem to be having a fun conversation. What's going on here?
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO! Oh, plus MEIKO and Luka☆ You just missed Tsukasa and Rui!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Their school's holding an arts festival, and their class is gonna put on a play for it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds enjoyable.
Have they already decided on one?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, they said...
They're paying homage to “The Phantom Of The Opera”!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To “The Phantom Of The Opera”?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. Apparently, their story involves rumors of a mysterious phantom hiding underground below this one popular theatre...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: One day, the protagonist, a young actor, decides to go investigate and find out the truth!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, it's the same as the original so far.
And then?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And then...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: He finds himself in a grassy field that he doesn't recognize at all...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? A grassy field...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah! He was sent to another world!
That's where his adventure begins, which is gonna be filled with both sadness and joy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. That's quite the twist.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It sounds like a wonderful surprise.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still... Ending up in a completely unfamiliar place...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That sounds like Tsukasa and the others when we first met them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about the first time they came to SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The look on Tsukasa's face when he saw me and the plushies was so priceless!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wasn't it? So, I think they have a good understanding of what it's actually like to be sent to another world.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right...! Then, Tsukasa's probably gonna do an amazing job as the lead!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I also wonder what Rui will decide to do as the director.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
The inclusion of another world points towards fantasy...
Rui should have plenty of opportunities to wow the audience.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I kinda feel like doing a show now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we do one together?
Something about being sent to another world!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ooh☆ I wanna do that too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, let's start coming up with a story!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sounds like fun!
Where would you like to be sent, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Me?
Well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If I were to choose... I'd wanna be sent to a really big school!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A big school?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! A school where us, the plushies, Tsukasa, the others and all sorts of people attend as students!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We'd wake up at this school to discover that we're all classmates!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Us as classmates...?
Hehe. That does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Exactly!
We'd study together, hang out around campus after school...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
And there's the school festival!
We could do a show with the plushies!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But something bad would happen while preparing for it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Something bad?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A group of bad guy plushies suddenly appears! They start messing up the school and attacking our plushie friends!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh no!
But we would've been having so much fun preparing for our show☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why we're gonna stand up against them as a class and drive them out!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that's really cool!
We'd be the ones saving our friends and the school festival♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm getting all excited just talking about this show♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Nice idea, Len!
It definitely sounds like a fun show.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
Then, let's keep working on it together!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for bringing over a copy of your movie for us, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I did promise to bring it over once it was finished. Anyway, let's watch it together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how the story we helped you come up with turned out☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A film directed by Nene! I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Quit playing up the whole “director” thing...
Okay, I'm hitting play now.

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“Far in the future...
A series of disasters has led humanity to the brink of extinction...”

rows.Speaker: Wandering Cook
rows.Line: “I'm just a humble cook...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, it's Akito!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa! Did you see that roundhouse kick?!
I could hear his leg go all whoosh!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The Dark Cook got blown away by that blast! That was so cool☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. No matter how many times I see it, the cinematography here astounds me. Taking this scene using drones makes it feel so much more dramatic.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, it has quite the impact!
This must've been very hard to actually pull off, no?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Cool, strong heroes like this really are awesome!
I wanna know what he does next on his journey!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I also wanna play a character like him...)
After the screening

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you all for watching...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank you for showing us! It was a great film, Nene! I'm glad we got to see it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Time really flies by when you're having fun! The hero was so cool, and so were the stunts...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Nene! Are you gonna make a sequel?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? A sequel?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I really appreciate the interest, but I doubt that's gonna happen.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's understandable...
This involved your entire class, so it won't be easy to make another one...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's make it ourselves☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you guys are gonna make it...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup☆
What do you guys think?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure. It could be fun to make a film for a change instead of putting on shows!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm in too♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, I wanna play the Wandering Cook!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm gonna play a super cool hero like him!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay♪
Then, Len can be our hero☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, what else do we need to do?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I wanna be the director☆
That's such a cool title!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then, I'll be behind the camera...
Let's do our best to make our actors look as good as we can, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll be counting on you two!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is starting to sound like a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, I'll need to bring over some film equipment that you can all use.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, and the clapperboard! You've gotta say, “Action!”♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nene, you're gonna be the first one to watch it once it's done!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's gonna be so cool!
And just as good as the one your class made, if not better!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, then...
I'll be looking forward to seeing it.
Len and Rin's anniversary
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think it should be okay now, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Um, Kanade...
And everyone... Thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Thank you for taking me shopping on my anniversary...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha. You're welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Besides, we're the ones who should be thanking you. This'll make for a nice break.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why are you looking at me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because you're the one who needs it the most.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: By the way, where's Rin? It's also her anniversary. I thought we were going to look for a gift together...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cake...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They're taking you shopping because you don't know what you want, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I've already decided, so I don't need to go.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. Rin would like cake.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There're so many different kinds, though...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's where we come in, isn't it? We should be able to pick a cake to Rin's exact preferences!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Look over there. Len's on screen.

rows.Speaker: Ena, Len & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh?
<Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hello everyone! It's me, Kagamine Len and...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Kagamine Rin!
You haven't forgotten our anniversary event today, have you?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <In the chat segments, we'll be interviewing each other!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You'll also be able to watch it on livestream, so I hope you can make it!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Alright, we'll be waiting on stage!>

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: <See you later!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, you meant the Rin and Len over here.
I freaked out when you said Len was on screen.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um... I didn't know the me in your world is having a celebration too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. It seems like they do it every year.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I know that it's a different version of me, but... I'm happy for him.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You really are kind, Len.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I think it's now time to go get a gift for our Len!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wow... There's so many CDs. I wouldn't know which one to pick.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In that case, let's pick something based on the cover! Shall we try that out?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... I made my choice after imagining what sort of cover you would like, Len, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, yours has a photo on it.
Mizuki's and Ena's have illustrations, and Mafuyu's...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is super simple! I would've never thought they'd just have the album title on a plain white cover.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We're supposed to be picking something as Len's potential gift. You could've picked something cuter.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu

rows.Line: “We find a kind boy working hard on his sword fighting skills, but his timid nature prevents him from improving.”

“That's it.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Big Brother
rows.Line: “Hey, you know you're never going to get stronger if you keep acting that way...”

rows.Speaker: Little Brother
rows.Line: “But!”

rows.Line: “The young man tugs the boy along as they set off on their journey to defeat the ogre.”

rows.Line: This is bad!

rows.Line: “Put all your valuables on the ground and leave!”

rows.Line:
“We have to create our own exit...!
Like this!”

rows.Line: Wow! He just took out all those bandits while dodging their attacks!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That's quite the physical feat.

rows.Speaker: Little Brother
rows.Line: “Whoa...!”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Our two brothers continue their journey as the villagers thank them for their heroism along the way.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “And the boy, who started out so timid, began to feel all this courage welling up inside of him.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“Finally, they arrive at their destination.
The mountain where the ogre is rumored to dwell...”

rows.Speaker: Burly Ogre
rows.Line: “Well met. I have been watching what you have both been doing from up here. You are heroes to those villagers, but do you have the skills to match...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She looks so powerful...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... She hasn't moved an inch, but she's exuding this terrifying aura...

rows.Speaker: Burly Ogre
rows.Line: “Hah! Looks like your bark was worse than your bite!”

rows.Line: “No! My sword...!”

rows.Line: “Gwah!”

rows.Line: No, he lost!

“Is it your turn now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Miku said she'd be around here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Aha...!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There you are, MEIKO! I finally found you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hello, Len.
Were you looking for me just now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yup.
I wanted to ask you about that fragment.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Remember how we got separated after being sent over to that SEKAI together?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Can you tell me more about where you went after we got split up?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, can you tell me about what happened on your end as well?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, while I was witnessing how Akito and Toya first met, you were with An the whole time?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. She practiced and performed in events all by herself, while looking very hard for someone she could call her partner.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But that must've been really hard.
I mean, she didn't meet Kohane until high school, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which means... She kept searching for over two years?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not only did she struggle to find a good partner, she had to deal with a lot of naysayers.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Naysayers?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. That fragment only allowed me to catch glimpses of what happened up until she met Kohane...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I was able to see how people's thoughts regarding RAD WEEKEND changed on Vivid Street as more and more time progressed.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Immediately following it, a lot of people wanted to put on an event that would surpass it. But it would soon turn into “that legendary night”, which nobody would ever surpass.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As the competition increased, and as people began to try harder and harder, both the performers and their audience slowly began coming to terms with a harsh reality.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Putting on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND would be impossibly difficult.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Right...
So, everyone around her...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As more and more began to revere RAD WEEKEND as “that legendary night”, the number of people hoping to surpass it dwindled significantly.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Trying to find a partner who'd allow her to surpass that night must've been so hard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, very hard.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But hard work and dedication ultimately pays off.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, because she found the best partner she could've asked for in Kohane!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This sort of applies to everyone in all the other SEKAI too, but fate, it seems, has a strange sense of humor...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
